$comment: engine.airunits balance data (MOD-074, mkey engine.airunits). Cites §26 Emergency & Care Dispatch Model (the air ambulance ignores roads; weather-limited; 1 air unit ≈ 10 ground units of marginal coverage in congested eras — the anti-gridlock asset), §10 Service & Feature Inventory (the air-ambulance pad: M8+DP, 4M, 1 unit, beats traffic), §28 Crime, Policing & Security (more police = less crime, concave deterrence in patrol coverage — the police-chopper coverage-extension precedent), and §54 The Fiscal Circuit (the Public Service Pie per-1k staffing targets, police ~2.4/1k — the approval/staffing tie-in). Design (Aaron 2026-08-15, BOW MOD-074): four rotary-wing roles (police, fire, ambulance, VIP/commercial), EXPENSIVE (very high purchase CAPEX + multi-component OPEX: fuel, hangar, insurance, crew), SKILLED (no pilot, no flight), MAINTENANCE-HEAVY (engineer-hours + downtime), EFFECTIVE (role-specific reach), POPULAR (approval from not-stuck-in-traffic), TRAFFIC-IMMUNE (road-independent, weather-limited). EVERY numeric figure in this file is a PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's row-by-row balance pass; the tested invariants are DIRECTION and STRUCTURE (a chopper costs more than a ground unit; a flying chopper costs more than a grounded one; two roles differ; four distinct effects), never a specific magnitude (balance-number regime, engine.maintenance.md AC-16 / engine.finance.md AC-21 precedent). Rebalancing is a data edit, never a code change.

meta.note: Placeholders pending Aaron's balance pass. UNITS: purchaseCostMicroPounds, fuelCostMicroPounds, hangarCostMicroPounds, insuranceCostMicroPounds, crewCostMicroPounds and commercialRevenuePerMonth are MICRO-POUNDS (1 GBP = 1,000,000 micro-pounds, matching engine.finance's Money type); unlockMilestone is a MILESTONE TIER INDEX (higher = later; a purchase is rejected below its tier, making choppers mechanically a late-game asset); coverageRadiusExtension is COVERAGE UNITS; remoteFireReachBonus is BLOCK-LOSS-REDUCTION UNITS; hospitalLandingReductionMinutes is SIMULATION-MINUTES; wearPerFlightCycle is WEAR POINTS per flight cycle; outOfServiceWearThreshold is WEAR POINTS (out-of-service when accumulated wear reaches it); engineerHoursPerWearPoint is ENGINEER-HOURS per wear point; approvalWeightPerActiveChopper is APPROVAL POINTS per active chopper; groundingWindKnots is WIND SPEED IN KNOTS (adverse weather at or above it grounds air dispatch); airSpeedMinutesPerUnit is SIMULATION-MINUTES per distance unit.
meta.effectUnit: coverage units / block-loss-reduction units / simulation-minutes / micro-pounds (per role)
